item.title: CVE-2026-102529: HtmlSanitizer: CSS Removal DoS
item.description:
Severity: high. ### Impact
An unauthenticated request can occupy one synchronous application worker for seconds. Concurrent requests add CPU cost and can keep all workers busy, sustaining denial of service without user interaction.
### Patches
The issue has been patched in versions 9.0.967 and 9

item.title: CVE-2026-115472: Doorkeeper: When using public clients, any client can revoke any access token
item.description:
Severity: medium. ### Summary
An improper authorization issue affects Doorkeeper's OAuth token revocation flow when public (non-confidential) clients are in use. This vulnerability can lead to tokens being revoked without correct authorization. The issue is fixed in Doorkeeper 5.9.1.

item.title: CVE-2026-58214: NATS Server MQTT subscribe permission bypass exposes internal QoS 2 metadata
item.description:
Severity: medium. ### Background
NATS.io is a high performance open source pub-sub distributed communication technology, built for the cloud, on-premise, IoT and edge computing.
The NATS Server MQTT support uses internal `$MQTT.*` subjects to implement MQTT protocol features such as QoS handling.
